ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity pixel distribution (>90% dark region) with sparse, localized high-intensity pixel clusters (white) concentrated on the central surface and tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous dark-tone region across both lobes. High-contrast white pixel clusters are mapped as discrete focal spots in the central-left area and along the trailing edges. Linear white pixel paths are mapped across the mid-surface of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Visible V-shaped central depression with a sharp interior vertex dividing the two lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency pixel-amplitude variations along the trailing edge boundary, manifesting as irregular jagged peaks and valleys, particularly pronounced on the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve trajectory along the trailing edge of both lobes, tapering to distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, roughly circular high-contrast pixel clusters (beige/white) concentrated on the distal tips and right-side trailing edge boundary.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Numerous unaligned, high-contrast white linear pixel streaks (scratches) distributed across both the left and right ventral surfaces.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive peripheral calcified-type accretions (barnacles) on the distal tips and segments of the trailing edges.
